answer: The lotus register is checked at draw time, atlas lists the eligible set, and kernel seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 76 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 76 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. Bonded capital sits idle for 8 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
